scope: One new algorithmic factor: train-only inner4 selection of a single common L2 inverse-regularization C on frozen regional1024 features. Existing C1 recipes remain HOLD.
outer2_is_not_pristine_never_used_data: Older outer0/1 fits included fold2 weak training labels, and hypothesis/representation choices adapt to earlier experiments. This stage has not evaluated outer2 as a holdout; do not claim an unbiased whole-project nested-CV estimate or independent patients.

target_boundary.future_training_view: Verify original file/cohort hashes, parse metadata UID/fold/group/source for every row, and skip fold2 before any target-cell access, target projection, number conversion, label validation or target retention. Return weak targets only for exactly3319 outertrain UIDs; only2409 feature-success rows can fit.
target_boundary.shared_CSV_physical_bytes: Whole-file hashing and CSV syntax parsing can process bytes containing outer2 targets. No claim that these bytes are physically unread. The forbidden operation is logical access/projection/conversion/storage/use of heldout target cells.
target_boundary.outer2_view: Only888 metadata UID/group/fold/source records plus independently qualified features/failure mask. No target columns or support counts returned, saved, fitted or scored until the separate controlled release stage.
target_boundary.old_load_weak_inputs_forbidden: H.load_weak_inputs and existing regional loaders project/validate targets for all4207 rows, so they must not be used for this new training boundary.
target_boundary.Gold_or_Report: Never use Gold label files/columns, Report text, Public score or leaderboard for C selection or this gate. Gold exclusions are inherited from the pinned metadata audit; no Gold target file read is needed.

head_constants.missing_labels: skip per-target missing labels; only observed0/1, never fill0
head_constants.standardization: One float64 StandardScaler per inner train partition, fit on its successful training features only (population variance, constant columns scale1), shared by its12 heads. Never include inner-validation or outer2 features in fitting the scaler.

selection.group_assignments: Reuse unchanged original folds; supplied/report groups cannot cross train/validation. Do not reshuffle, make new folds or split a multi-study group.
selection.objective: For each C, mean of the4 innerfold macro fixed10 standalone head AUCs; equivalently equal mean of all40 finite AUCs. Use successful inner-validation rows with target-observed0/1 only, same UID/missing mask for every C. No native baseline, rankmix, pooled crossfold AUC, BCE or auxiliary target contributes to selection.
selection.score_precision: Compute standalone AUC from float64 numeric-model probabilities using the pinned H metric/rank algorithm, no score rounding or FP32 rankmix in the selection objective. Deployment FP32 rankmix remains unchanged.
selection.preflight_support: Before any C fit, require two observed classes in every fixed10 target's successful inner-train and successful inner-validation subset for each innerfold. If any of40 comparisons is undefined, HOLD the entire recipe; do not omit/replace targets or folds.
selection.C_ineligibility: If any fixed10 inner head for a C has ConvergenceWarning, other fit warning, nonfinite parameters/probabilities or fails numeric JSON/NumPy/sklearn FP32 parity, mark that entire C ineligible. Do not alter max_iter/tol, retry, warm-start or add another C.
selection.auxiliary_targets: MCL/Synovitis use the same C whenever supported but never influence C score. Insufficient classes/nonconvergence stays explicit unsupported with null coefficients/NaN predictions; never fill0 or replace labels. They remain baseline-only at rankmix.
selection.all_C_ineligible: HOLD, no model refit, no replacement grid or alternative objective.
selection.tie_rule: Let smax be maximum eligible unrounded score. Among Cs with smax-score <=1e-12 choose the smallest numeric C (strongest L2 regularization). No statistical significance or outer result enters the tie.
selection.C1_wins: Keep winner C1 without an additional retry; record that the selected numerical regularization equals the old C1 value. This does not reverse the old outer01 HOLD or prove shrinkage improved anything.
selection.maximum_fits: 4 Cs x4 innerfolds x12 heads =192 inner fits, plus at most12 heads in ONE selected-C outertrain refit. Auxiliary unsupported targets may reduce count. No repeated seeds or second search.

one_model_and_prediction_seal.refit: Exactly one12-head numeric model at selected common C on all2409 successful outertrain rows (original folds0/1/3/4), train-only scaler. No refit for losing Cs, no alternative C1 outer2 comparator, no per-target C and no model ensemble.
one_model_and_prediction_seal.refit_failure: If any fixed10 head is unqualified or numerical export parity fails, HOLD. Do not fall back to the second-ranked C or change target masks/hyperparameters.
one_model_and_prediction_seal.outer2_predictions: Generate and seal raw float64 probabilities and their FP32 values for exactly654 successful outer2 UIDs, plus full888 UID order/failure234 metadata; missing feature rows have no head vector, never a zero vector. Do not attach target columns or compute outer2 AUC yet.
one_model_and_prediction_seal.future_test_model: Only this single sealed selected-C outertrain model is eligible for later transport consideration. Training on all4207, a second model, an ensemble or a new representation requires a separately recorded prospective decision; none is authorized by this plan.
one_model_and_prediction_seal.existing_adapters: Old256/fold0 adapter and existing FD/regional fold0/1 adapter do not qualify this new outer2 producer/C metadata. Future transport needs its own source/qualification binding.

outer2_control_and_gate.required_control: New independent F006 fold2 fixedepoch12 control for exactly888 UID set, pinned source/config/checkpoint/prediction hashes and engineering audit. Never substitute trained-on-fold2 F006 fold0/1 predictions, bestBCE/maxAUC checkpoint or their ensemble.
outer2_control_and_gate.release_order: First freeze selected-C model and outer2 predictions without targets. Wait for qualified F006 fold2 E12 control. Root separately authorizes outer2 target-view release after checking prediction/control seals. Then evaluate this ONE candidate ONCE; no target-dependent changes after release.
outer2_control_and_gate.primary: Unchanged H rank_blend/evaluate math: baseline s0=FP32 average_rank(F006 raw)/888 for full outer2, assert baseline/raw masked AUC equality. Supported fixed10 successful head q=FP32 average_rank(FP32 headprob)/654; mix FP32(.8*s0)+FP32(.2*q) with separate products then FP32sum. Preserve baseline bits for failed features, MCL/Synovitis and unsupported/degenerate head. Primary is mean fixed10 masked AUC delta over ALL888 outer2 rows.
outer2_control_and_gate.proposed_gate_frozen_here: Engineering-qualified input/model/control, all fixed10 refit heads qualified, and full888 fixed10 AUC delta>0 permits root to CONSIDER one Public candidate. delta<=0 or any unqualified primary AUC means HOLD, no coefficient/C/target/region/retry search on the same outer2 result. Positive does not authorize upload or guarantee Public gain.
outer2_control_and_gate.secondary_report_only: All12 and per-target AUC, success-only paired raw/rank baseline equality and head/blend AUC, coverage/domain/label support, BCE, paired supplied-group bootstrap1000 seed20261012 and95%CI. CI/BCE never choose C, weights or pass/fail.
outer2_control_and_gate.outer01: No new refits/re-evaluation on outer0/1 for this recipe; historical results remain adaptive context only, not an extra pass/fail screen.

implementation_design.fit_numeric_C1_literal: Old H.fit_numeric hardcodes C1. Implement a new isolated producer with a reviewed clone/parameterized fit_numeric_C; apart from validated C argument and new provenance, assert original fit/scaler/solver/numeric-export function AST equivalence. Do not edit H or monkeypatch old fit/LogisticRegression.
implementation_design.new_files_later: Separate inner-C producer/CLI, training-only label-view constructor, selection/seal artifact schema, outer2-release evaluator and narrowly scoped CPU synthetic QA. Exact names/hash freeze after root design review; nothing implemented here.

No real weak fit until root instruction.

limitations: C is inverse L2 strength; smaller C may reduce capacity but does not lower the fixed20 rankmix weight. Once ranked, compressed probability scale alone does not reduce contribution.
Train-validation gaps support an overfitting hypothesis, not proof that C selection fixes the much weaker standalone representation or its complementarity to F006.
Fixed regional1024 uses the previously selected RSNA adapter; author orientation/SAP equivalence and causal failure reason are not established.
Only observed0/1 weak labels, nonrandom75% feature coverage, supplied/report group independence only; Gold, patient independence, Public accuracy and0.960 remain unqualified.
This bounded inner grid is planned model selection on training data, not a retune of the failed old outer01 C1 recipe. Hypothesis adaptation to old outcomes is disclosed.
